set policy-map qos-profile-1.explanation: This command fragment configures a policy map named `[parameter1]` in Junos, defining traffic classification and actions for Quality of Service (QoS) policies.

parameters.name: policy-map
parameters.explanation: Policy map names, such as qos-profile-1.

class class-default.explanation: This Junos command fragment configures a policy map by associating a specific traffic class (`parameter2`) with a defined policy action or behavior (`parameter1`).

priority 10000.explanation: This command assigns a priority level (`[parameter3]`) to traffic in class `[parameter2]` within the policy map `[parameter1]`, ensuring higher-priority handling for that class.

bandwidth-shared 2000.explanation: Configure the priority and shared bandwidth of the QoS policy map.

set policy-map global out put qos-profil.explanation: Configure the output of the global policy map.

set forwarding-options mac-ceiling md 1.explanation: Configure MAC caps for forward options.

set forwarding-options mac-ceiling ma 1.explanation: This command sets the maximum number of MAC addresses (`ma`) that can be learned on a specific interface or VLAN, limiting MAC table size to `[parameter1]`.

ma 1.explanation: This command sets a MAC address limit (ceiling) for a specific MAC address (parameter1) and another MAC address (parameter2) in the forwarding options.
